Flag service births that equal population births, before merging

Source: R/0_data_quality_checks.R
check_population_service_collision_presheet.Rd

Runs check_population_service_collision() on the unmerged sheets. It finds district-years where the monthly institutional live births in the service sheets equal the annual live births in the Population sheet in every month, which suggests that population figures were entered in a service data sheet.

Usage

check_population_service_collision_presheet(
  parts,
  population_sheet_name,
  service_sheet_names
)

Arguments

parts

A named list of cleaned per-sheet tibbles (load_excel_parts()$parts).

population_sheet_name

A string. The name of the Population sheet within parts.

service_sheet_names

A character vector. The names of the service data sheets within parts.

Value

A tibble with columns district and year, one row per flagged district-year. It has no rows if nothing is flagged, if the Population sheet lacks district, year or live_births, or if the service sheets lack instlivebirths.

Details

The service sheets are stacked and the Population sheet's live_births is added to each service row by district and year. Every service row is kept. A district-year is flagged when it has at least three months with both values present and the two values are equal in all of them.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core")
sheets <- load_excel_parts(path)
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
check_population_service_collision_presheet(
  sheets$parts, sheets$population_sheet_name, sheets$service_sheet_names
)
#> # A tibble: 0 × 2
#> # ℹ 2 variables: district <chr>, year <int>

# Baringo's 2023 population births entered in every month of the service sheet
parts <- sheets$parts
population <- parts[[sheets$population_sheet_name]]
births <- population$live_births[population$district == "Baringo" & population$year == 2023]
service <- parts[[sheets$service_sheet_names[1]]]
service$instlivebirths[service$district == "Baringo" & service$year == 2023] <- births
parts[[sheets$service_sheet_names[1]]] <- service
check_population_service_collision_presheet(
  parts, sheets$population_sheet_name, sheets$service_sheet_names
)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 2
#>   district  year
#>   <chr>    <int>
#> 1 Baringo   2023
